description: Assign, unassign, close, escalate or reopen a single report. Requires a service JWT obtained from the caller PDS (com.atproto.server.getServiceAuth) with aud set to the admin service DID and lxm set to the invoked method.

scope.description: Closure scope for close: the current report, all open reports on the subject, or only the given report types. Omit to close only the current report.

reportTypes.description: Report types to close when scope is types.

did.description: Moderator DID for assign. Defaults to the caller.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller lacks the permission for this method.

errors.name: NotConfigured
errors.description: The upstream service credential is not configured.

errors.name: UpstreamAuthFailed
errors.description: The upstream service rejected the administrator credential.

errors.name: UpstreamUnavailable
errors.description: The upstream service is unreachable or timed out.

errors.name: RateLimited
errors.description: The upstream service rate limited the request.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The action cannot be applied to this report.
